items.name: Wall Curl
items.specific: Standing facing a simple vertical wall, both palms pressed flat against wall at waist height with fingers pointing down, elbows bent close to sides as if trying to curl upward against wall, both feet on floor. Side three-quarter view showing palms in contact with wall and downward pointing fingers.
items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one square exercise illustration for a fitness app, legible at 280 x 280 pixels. Input image 1: STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, not a pose reference. Match the reference closely: same adult male character, short dark brown hair, simple featureless face, light skin, gray short-sleeve T-shirt, dark navy shorts, white socks, gray sneakers. Same clean thin dark outlines, softly shaded flat instructional illustration, muted blue palette. Same pale blue background with a large lighter blue circle, dark blue rectangular border inset from a narrow white outer margin. Keep the whole body inside the border and leave breathing room. Change body orientation and camera angle as specified by the exercise. Keep clothing, character proportions and rendering consistent with input image 1. One person, exactly one frozen pose. Correct coherent anatomy and physically plausible support contacts. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, motion trails, multiple panels, ghost limbs or watermark. Include only equipment required by the exercise.

Primary request: illustrate Wall Curl. Standing facing a simple vertical wall, both palms pressed flat against wall at waist height with fingers pointing down, elbows bent close to sides as if trying to curl upward against wall, both feet on floor. Side three-quarter view showing palms in contact with wall and downward pointing fingers.

Correction: Use a rear three-quarter view looking over the athlete's shoulder toward a broad flat wall in front of him. Both arms reach forward to the wall. Both palms are pressed flat directly against its visible near surface, fingers straight and pointing downward, with no gap between either palm and wall. Elbows bent near the torso. Both feet flat on floor. Make both palms visibly on the wall, not hanging in front of it.

items.specific: Bottom of one-arm push-up: one palm planted on floor beneath chest, that elbow bent, torso low and body straight, legs spread wide with both toes on floor, other hand held behind lower back and not touching floor. Front three-quarter view showing single arm support.
